rule: Among seven unanimous ordinary predictions, override when party and solo-specific gradient tree and logistic spline both favor the opposite label and each absolute log-odds change over its own global model exceeds the absolute median foundation log-odds.
local_validation: Both global and party/solo tree and spline architectures refit on each of eight random-order folds and eight contiguous-order folds; original seven opinion sources and scored parent unchanged between protocols.
limitations: Exploratory selection from 30 declared policy comparisons. The seven ordinary OOF outputs and the anchor are fixed across both protocols. The new expert architectures are independently refitted in both splits; 1,033 historically unseen passengers are 1 fixed and 1 harmed in each.
